method: Read exact application-exported CharacterPacks. Pixel metrics use native192x272 RGBA. Original metrics use one common uniform presentation scale to272-high frames with LANCZOS, not altered archives. Alpha>128 upper silhouette defines crown top; crown center is midpoint of opaque horizontal bounds in the top75 pixels. These are silhouette registration proxies, not a claim of anatomical landmark truth. Celebration raised hands can contaminate the crown proxy; do not interpret celebration metrics as head-motion measurement.
findings: The pixel run banks do not have greater absolute vertical amplitude than original; their motion is less regular and less temporally sampled, with independently drawn face/perspective changes.
Female base idle/walk have large avoidable horizontal registration drift.
Male/female base walk second-half crown height differs while soles remain250–251, so full-frame vertical locking would float shoes.
Wedding crowns are already laterally registered; further X locking alone does not solve face/shape variation.
